items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: there were so many good musicians in that band. And there was a trumpet player, we used to call him Linc. His name was Lincoln [Mills]... He was a fantastic trumpet player.

ctx.x: And let's see -- there were so many good musicians in that band. And there was a trumpet player, we used to call him Linc. His name was Lincoln [Mills], but everybody called him Linc. He was a fantastic trumpet player.
